props.name: orientation
props.description:
Layout direction of the group.

- **horizontal** (default): buttons sit side by side, divided by a vertical hairline.
- **vertical**: buttons stack top to bottom, divided by a horizontal hairline.

props.name: theme
props.description: Fallback theme applied to child buttons that don't set their own `theme`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Fallback variant applied to child buttons that don't set their own `variant`.

props.name: size
props.description: Fallback size applied to child buttons that don't set their own `size`.

props.name: rounded
props.description:
Rounds the group's outer corners into a full pill shape instead of the
size-matched corner radius.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description:
Stretches child buttons to share the group's width (horizontal) or
height (vertical) equally.

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible label describing the purpose of the group.
Rendered as `aria-label` on the `role="group"` container.
